description_en: Removes one or more ApsaraDB RDS instances
kebab_example: aliyun ess detach-db-instances --scaling-group-id asg-bp1igpak5ft1flyp0000 --db-instance rm-bp12cy30000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachDBInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove the private IP addresses of instances in the scaling group from the IP whitelist of the RDS instance when the RDS instance is removed from the scaling group. Valid values:

true: Removes the private IP addresses.

false: Does not remove the private IP addresses.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
当RDS实例从伸缩组移除时，是否移除RDS实例IP白名单中属于伸缩组内实例的私网IP。取值范围：

true：移除。

false：不移除。

默认值：false
parameters.name: force_detach

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25965.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the RDS instance. You can remove up to five RDS instances at a time
parameters.help_zh: RDS实例的ID，单次最多支持移除5个RDS实例
parameters.name: db_instance

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove the security group whitelist that was added when the scaling group was associated with the database. This parameter takes effect only for databases whose `AttachMode` parameter is set to `SecurityGroup`. Valid values:

true: Removes the security group ID that was added when the scaling group was associated with the database.
false: Does not remove the security group ID that was added when the scaling group was associated with the database.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩组是否移除关联数据库时添加的安全组白名单。仅针对`AttachMode`参数取值为`SecurityGroup`的数据库有效，取值范围：

true：会移除伸缩组关联数据库时添加的安全组ID。
false：不会移除伸缩组关联数据库时添加的安全组ID。

默认值：false
parameters.name: remove_security_group
